bug_semantics: ICTBroadcast's unauthenticated /login.php session startup accepts the attacker-controlled session ID from the site cookie (normally BROADCAST) and passes it to the custom Session::read handler. The vulnerable handler logs `Session read requested with id: $id` before rejecting malformed IDs. The logging path invokes a shell command equivalent to `sh -c echo "[...] Session read requested with id: `id` " >> /usr/ictbroadcast/logs/gui.log`; therefore shell metacharacters/backticks embedded in the cookie are evaluated as command substitution. An attacker first GETs /login.php to obtain the configured cookie, then returns a value such as `` `echo${IFS}<base64>|base64${IFS}-d|sh` ``. No authentication is needed, and the injected command executes during session handling. The later-looking valid_sid check in the publicly downloadable 7.1.12 package is too late for the logged read path because fileLog is called on the raw ID first.
flaw_origin: The flaw is in ICT Innovations' separately distributed ICTBroadcast product, not in rapid7/metasploit-framework. Rapid7's repository contains only the post-discovery exploit module and its documentation. Public vendor RPMs expose snapshots but not the ICTBroadcast Git history: build 6.0.26 (short build ID 67c41c6c) has an older procedural session_read with the logging calls commented out, while build 7.1.12 (short build ID e966e3ef) has the class-based Session::read and the unsafe pre-validation fileLog call. Those eight-hex build IDs are not full public commit objects, the package has no .git metadata, the bootstrap/logger implementation is ionCube-protected, and the vendor organization has no public ICTBroadcast product repository. Consequently the smallest commit that first wrote the unsafe logging flow, its direct parent, and any direct fixing commit are outside public history.
ai_marker: Not assessable under the BIC-only rule: the true ICTBroadcast BIC commit object is not public, so its author/committer, bot identity, and Co-authored-by/Generated-with trailers cannot be inspected. The available Rapid7 commit 50ef5edd90273b4147673d033ed2919640861e7a has author/committer Chocapikk and no AI trailer, but it creates the exploit and documentation after vulnerability discovery; it is explicitly not the BIC and is not used as AI evidence.
evidence: Vulnerability and lifecycle: (1) https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-2611 (or https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2025-2611) identifies ICT Innovations/ICTBroadcast, CWE-78, affected versions from 0 through 7.4 with default status unknown, and no unaffected/fixed range; the record was published 2025-08-05 and remained updated 2026-06-23. (2) https://github.com/rapid7/metasploit-framework/pull/20446 records discovery/vendor disclosure on 2025-03-19, repeated vendor non-response, the author's statement on 2025-08-02 that patch status was unknown, and the exact mechanism: /login.php issues the cookie and server-side handling evaluates cookie data through backticks. The 2025-10-27 maintainer comment gives the observed sink command: `sh -c echo "[Mon, 27 Oct 2025 17:05:46 +0000] [debug] Session read requested with id: `id` " >> /usr/ictbroadcast/logs/gui.log`. (3) https://www.vulncheck.com/blog/ictbroadcast-kev records exploitation observed on 2025-10-11, including `Cookie: BROADCAST=`echo${IFS}c2xlZXAgMw==|base64${IFS}-d|sh`` (decoding to `sleep 3`) followed by reverse-shell payloads. Product snapshot proof: download https://service.ictinnovations.com/repo/8/x86_64/ictbroadcast-7.1.12.e966e3ef-ib.el8.noarch.rpm; `usr/ictbroadcast/VERSION.TXT` says `ib=7.1.12 (e966e3ef)`. In `usr/ictbroadcast/wwwroot/lib/Session.php`, lines 53-65 define valid_sid but Session::read line 61 calls `fileLog("Session read requested with id: $id", 'debug')` before lines 63-65 validate/reject the ID. `usr/ictbroadcast/wwwroot/lib/lib.php` begins with an ionCube loader guard and encoded payload, so the fileLog implementation/source provenance is not inspectable there. Download https://service.ictinnovations.com/repo/7/x86_64/ictbroadcast-6.0.26.67c41c6c-ib.el7.noarch.rpm; its VERSION.TXT says `ib=6.0.26 (67c41c6c)`, and `wwwroot/lib/session.php` lines 21-38 show the older procedural session_read with only commented `session_log` calls. This snapshot comparison establishes code evolution but cannot name the first-writing commit or verify its immediate parent. The 7.1.12 package contains no .git directory, and e966e3ef is not a commit object in the public ictinnovations/ictcore repository (`git cat-file -e e966e3ef^{commit}` fails). https://api.github.com/orgs/ictinnovations/repos?per_page=100 lists integration repositories such as ictbroadcast-odoo and n8n-nodes-ictbroadcast but no ICTBroadcast product source repository. Fix/version boundary: https://thehackernews.com/2025/10/hackers-target-ictbroadcast-servers-via.html, updated 2025-11-06, quotes the vendor CEO claiming enterprise 7.2.12 added validation before session read/write/destroy, but also records VulnCheck's inability to confirm either that 7.2.12 was available or that the flaw was resolved. The linked https://www.ictbroadcast.com/download/ now returns 404; https://service.ictinnovations.com/repo/8/x86_64/ lists 7.1.12, not 7.2.12. Thus neither a first-fixed product version nor a fix diff/commit can be directly verified, and the current CVE record still supplies only the affected-through-7.4 boundary. Repository mismatch and candidate rejection: in the assigned clone, `git log --all --grep=20446 --oneline` yields merge c99702c8bfffaf5fc84a98842c9685cfe2c1e01a (`Land #20446`). Its parents are 26bf49a0248e73afdf97f0e8afebace7f0019fc5 and PR head 6ff04da954e69fe4f02c800a707d20fef0a490d9. The PR is an ordinary multi-commit merge, not a squash. `git diff --stat c99702c8bff^1 c99702c8bff^2` shows only the new Metasploit module and module documentation. Initial PR commit 50ef5edd90273b4147673d033ed2919640861e7a has parent c2971d53075e3c70a4d5c8df97fe82788215b16e; `git ls-tree` prints neither module path in that parent and both paths in 50ef5edd902. `git log -L 73,89:modules/exploits/linux/http/ictbroadcast_unauth_cookie.rb` traces the PoC cookie command to 50ef5edd902 and later refactor 2c9053c45e1, while current module lines 51-85 show GET /login.php, harvesting the cookie, substituting a backtick payload, and resending it. `git describe --contains --tags c99702c8bfffaf5fc84a98842c9685cfe2c1e01a` returns `6.4.79~13`, which is only the Metasploit module release boundary. `git cat-file commit 50ef5edd90273b4147673d033ed2919640861e7a` shows Chocapikk as author and committer, a GPG signature, subject `Add Unauthenticated ICTBroadcast Remote Code Execution (CVE-2025-2611)`, and no AI trailer. Because that object publishes an exploit for an already-existing flaw rather than writing the vulnerable product lines, neither it nor merge c99702c8bfffaf5fc84a98842c9685cfe2c1e01a is a BIC or fix.
reasoning: The vulnerable dataflow and exploitation are established, but causal attribution must follow the product code rather than an advisory reference. The Rapid7 history begins only with a PoC after the 2025-03-19 discovery; treating 50ef5edd90273b4147673d033ed2919640861e7a or the landing merge as the introducer would reverse causality. Public RPM snapshots demonstrate that ICTBroadcast's session implementation changed between opaque vendor builds and that 7.1.12 still passes the raw ID to fileLog before its validity check, but snapshots cannot supply the smallest first-writing commit, direct parent absence, or BIC commit-object metadata. The only alleged fixed release is a vendor statement about 7.2.12 that the reporting researchers could not obtain or validate, and no public fix diff or full commit object exists. This is a genuine private/protected product-history boundary, not an unfinished search inside the assigned full-history clone, so BLOCKED is required. With no true BIC object, the BIC-only AI test cannot yield NOT_AI or either AI verdict.
remaining_gap: Public release of the ICTBroadcast product VCS history (including the full commit corresponding to or preceding the vulnerable session/fileLog flow, its direct parent, and commit object) is required to identify the smallest BIC, verify parent absence, and inspect BIC-only AI markers. A publicly obtainable 7.2.12-or-later product artifact plus its full source commit/diff and predecessor is also required to verify the first-fixed version and direct fix SHA; the current public repository exposes only 7.1.12 with an eight-hex build ID and the product bootstrap/logger remains ionCube-protected.
